title: Cardinality of fixed-size restrictions
statement: Let $n$ and $k$ be natural numbers with $k \le n$. Among all restrictions on $n$ variables — maps assigning each variable either a fixed Boolean value or leaving it free — those whose set of free variables has cardinality exactly $k$ number precisely $\binom{n}{k}\,2^{\,n-k}$.
replaced:
For $k \le n$, the set of restrictions of $\mathrm{Fin}\,n$ leaving exactly $k$
variables free has cardinality $\binom{n}{k}\,2^{\,n-k}$, i.e.\ it equals
$\mathrm{numSRestrictions}\,n\,k$.
